::: {.callout-tip title="About this page" icon="false"}
A structured reference map of the Transformer era (2017 — present).
Organized three ways: chronological, by architecture family, and by
application area. Each entry cites the primary paper, names the key
formalization, and notes why it mattered. Use it as a reading guide or
as a lookup when a chapter references a work without full derivation.
:::

---

## Chronological timeline

Years reflect first public availability (arXiv or blog post). Citation links
point to the peer-reviewed venue, which may differ by up to one year.

## By architecture family

### Encoder-Decoder

The original Transformer family. Two stacks: an encoder that processes the
full source, a decoder that generates the target one token at a time with
cross-attention to encoder states.

| Work | Year | Specialization |
|---|---|---|
| Transformer [@vaswani2017] | 2017 | Machine translation |
| T5 [@raffel2020] | 2019 | Text-to-text unification |
| BART (Lewis et al.) | 2019 | Denoising autoencoder for summarisation |
| Whisper [@radford2022whisper] | 2022 | Multilingual speech recognition |
| mT5 (Xue et al.) | 2021 | Multilingual T5 |

The family peaked around 2020–2022. Decoder-only models at sufficient scale
can perform the same tasks, reducing the incentive to maintain a separate
encoder stack.

### Encoder-only

Pretrain a bidirectional Transformer on a self-supervised objective; then
fine-tune the encoder representations for downstream tasks. Strong for
classification, extraction, and retrieval; cannot generate fluently.

| Work | Year | Objective | Key strength |
|---|---|---|---|
| BERT [@devlin2019] | 2018 | MLM + NSP | Bidirectional; fine-tuning paradigm |
| RoBERTa [@liu2019roberta] | 2019 | MLM only | Better training recipe |
| ViT [@dosovitskiy2021] | 2020 | Image patch classification | Vision Transformers |
| CLIP [@radford2021clip] | 2021 | Contrastive image-text | Multimodal alignment |
| DeBERTa (He et al.) | 2020 | MLM + disentangled attention | Position-aware representations |

The family is now used primarily for embeddings and retrieval (bi-encoders,
dense passage retrieval) rather than generation.

### Decoder-only

Pretrain a causal (left-to-right) Transformer as a language model; scale the
model and the data. By 2022, this family dominates benchmarks and products.

| Work | Year | Params (approx.) | Key advance |
|---|---|---|---|
| GPT-1 [@radford2018gpt] | 2018 | 117M | Pretraining + fine-tuning |
| GPT-2 [@radford2019gpt2] | 2019 | 1.5B | Zero-shot transfer |
| GPT-3 [@brown2020] | 2020 | 175B | In-context learning; emergence |
| Codex [@chen2021codex] | 2021 | 12B | Code domain |
| InstructGPT [@ouyang2022] | 2022 | 175B | RLHF alignment |
| LLaMA [@touvron2023llama] | 2023 | 7–65B | Open weights; efficient arch |
| GPT-4 | 2023 | undisclosed | Multimodal; SOTA across benchmarks |
| o1 | 2024 | undisclosed | Test-time compute scaling |
| DeepSeek-R1 | 2025 | 671B (MoE) | Open reasoning model |

### Infrastructure and methods (non-architectural)

Works that changed how models are trained, aligned, or deployed — without
introducing a new architecture.

| Work | Year | Contribution |
|---|---|---|
| Scaling laws [@kaplan2020] | 2020 | Power-law training budgets |
| Chinchilla [@hoffmann2022] | 2022 | Optimal token/param ratio |
| Flash Attention [@dao2022flashattn] | 2022 | IO-aware exact attention |
| InstructGPT RLHF [@ouyang2022] | 2022 | PPO from human preferences |
| DPO [@rafailov2023] | 2023 | Preference alignment without RL |
| GQA (Ainslie et al.) | 2023 | Grouped-query attention for inference |
| RoPE [@su2024rope] | 2021/2023 | Rotary position encoding (arXiv 2021; adopted widely via LLaMA 2023) |
| AlphaFold 2 [@jumper2021] | 2021 | Evoformer — attention applied to protein structure |

## By application area

| Domain | Key papers | First viable | Current state |
|---|---|---|---|
| Machine translation | Transformer 2017 | 2017 | Transformer-based MT standard |
| NLU / QA / classification | BERT 2018 | 2018 | Fine-tuned encoders or few-shot LLMs |
| Text generation | GPT-2 2019 | 2019 | GPT-4, Claude, Gemini family |
| Code generation | Codex 2021 | 2022 (Copilot) | DeepSeek Coder, Claude, GPT-4o |
| Image classification | ViT 2020 | 2021 | ViT, DeiT, Swin Transformer |
| Image generation | CLIP + DDPM 2021 | 2022 (DALL-E 2) | Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, Flux |
| Speech recognition | Whisper 2022 | 2022 | Whisper large v3 |
| Protein structure | AlphaFold 2 2021 | 2021 | AF3, ESM3 |
| Reasoning | o1 2024 | 2024 | o1, o3, DeepSeek-R1 |
| Agents & tool use | GPT-4 + function calls 2023 | 2023 | Ongoing |
